rich_description: The Lease Buyback Scheme lets elderly HDB flat owners aged 65 and above sell the tail-end of their flat's lease back to HDB while continuing to live in the flat for a retained lease of 15 to 35 years. The proceeds are used to top up the household's CPF Retirement Account, which then pays out a monthly income for life via CPF LIFE — turning an illiquid flat into a steady retirement income stream without forcing the senior to move out. There is also a cash bonus of up to $30,000 paid in cash on top of the CPF top-up. This is meant for asset-rich-but-cash-poor seniors whose flat is their main asset and who need retirement income but want to age in place. Available for 3-room and smaller flats by default; 4-room owners are eligible if monthly household income is at or below $14,000. If your elderly parent owns a smaller flat in Tampines, has limited savings, and worries about running out of money in old age, this scheme converts the flat into lifetime monthly income without selling and moving.

other_criteria: At least one owner must be a Singapore citizen aged 65+
Own a 3-room or smaller HDB flat (4-room eligible if household income ≤ $14,000/month)
Flat must have at least 20 years of lease remaining
Applicant and spouse must not own any other property in Singapore or overseas
Household must commit to retain at least 15 years of lease

required_documents.name: Flat ownership documents
required_documents.notes: Title deed or HDB ownership confirmation

required_documents.name: CPF statements
required_documents.notes: Most recent CPF Retirement Account statement

oth_location: Level 3, HDB Tampines Branch (Customer Service Counters). HDB officers walk seniors through the financial projection and required CPF top-up before signing.
typical_processing_time: From application to completion typically 3-4 months. Includes a mandatory financial counselling session and a 1-week cool-off period after the agreement is offered.
